title: cordyline bellula
intro: Cordyline bellula, commonly known as the bellflower or cabbage tree, is a type of flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family. It is native to Australia and New Zealand, where it has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant has been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including cordyline glycosides and flavonoids, that have therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Cordyline bellula include improved cardiovascular health, enhanced immune function, and reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression.
